verification_candidates.claim_text: Black salve is an alternative topical therapy that was historically used to treat skin cancer.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: black s as an alternative topical therapy that was initially used back in the day to treat skin cancer

verification_candidates.claim_text: Black salve's main ingredients are bloodroot (Sanguinaria canadensis) and zinc chloride.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: One of them is blood root Sanguinaria canadensis like Canada, and the other is zinc chloride
verification_candidates.rationale: The specific composition claim about black salve's ingredients is checkable and relevant to understanding the caustic mechanism it relies on.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Black salve works by burning through layers of skin until the dead tissue falls off, leaving an open wound.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: it all basically works by just burning layers of your skin to death at a time
verification_candidates.rationale: This mechanistic claim about how black salve damages skin is checkable and central to understanding the harm the practice causes.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Online communities that promote treatments like black salve have caused deaths.
